content.text: You’ve spent months writing your ebook. The content is polished, the cover is designed, and your audience in Kenya is ready to buy. But when you try to set up payments, the roadblocks appear. Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. Local payment gateways charge exorbitant fees or fail to integrate. You’re left with no reliable way to collect payment and deliver your product automatically. This isn’t just a frustration—it’s a barrier to your livelihood. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solves this. It’s not a workaround; it’s a permanent solution. Your store runs on infrastructure you own, using tools that don’t depend on third-party platforms. Crypto payments are verified on-chain, and delivery is automated the moment payment confirms. No subscriptions, no platform lock-in, no geographic restrictions. This is how [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-minimum-viable-2|digital]] creators in Kenya and beyond reclaim control of their commerce.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-5. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a system that eliminates intermediaries. When a buyer sends cryptocurrency, the payment is verified on-chain. Once confirmed, the system automatically sends the ebook to the buyer’s email or download link. This process runs on infrastructure you own—no Stripe, no PayPal, no Gumroad. The core benefit is sovereignty. You’re not renting a platform; you’re deploying your own commerce stack. This means no geographic restrictions, no sudden shutdowns, and no reliance on services that don’t support your region. For digital creators in Kenya, this isn’t just convenient—it’s essential. Traditional payment gateways exclude you. This system doesn’t. It’s built to work where others fail, using tools like GitHub Pages, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-6|Cloudflare R2]] Workers, and NOWPayments. You own the code, the data, and the process. It’s commerce infrastructure designed for creators who need to operate without permission.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The system consists of four core components. First, a frontend store hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—free and globally accessible. Second, backend logic handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which processes payments and triggers delivery. Third, a database like Supabase or Google Sheets to store order details. Fourth, file storage using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure ebook delivery. When a buyer sends crypto, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain. A webhook fires, triggering the backend logic. The script checks the payment, retrieves the ebook file, and sends a download link to the buyer’s email. All this happens in seconds, without manual intervention. The architecture is modular—each component is replaceable, but they work together seamlessly. It’s designed to be lightweight, cost-effective, and fully automated. No server management, no ongoing fees, and no technical debt. Just reliable infrastructure that works anywhere.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is built for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software but are locked out of conventional payment platforms. If you’re in Kenya, Ghana, Zimbabwe, or any region where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent their commerce infrastructure. You don’t want to depend on platforms that can shut you down or change their terms overnight. This system gives you ownership. It’s for creators who value sovereignty over convenience. You’re not looking for a quick fix; you’re building a permanent solution. It’s also for creators who understand the power of crypto. By accepting 300+ cryptocurrencies, you open your products to a global audience without currency conversion headaches. This isn’t just a technical choice—it’s a strategic one. You’re choosing infrastructure that works on your terms, not someone else’s.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you ownership, not rentals.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in this system plays a critical role. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your store—free, fast, and globally accessible. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic, from payment verification to file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 hosts your ebook files for instant delivery. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook integration. These tools are chosen for their reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of use. They’re not just free or low-cost—they’re enterprise-grade. Cloudflare’s network ensures your store loads quickly worldwide. Google’s infrastructure provides scalability without complexity. NOWPayments’ webhook system ensures instant delivery the moment payment confirms. Together, these components form a sovereign commerce stack. You own every piece, and no single component is a single point of failure. It’s infrastructure designed to last.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours with GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments—ideal for beginners. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration. For full control, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for instant deployment. Once deployed, load your ebooks, set your prices in USD, and connect your crypto wallet to NOWPayments. Test the system end-to-end to ensure payments trigger delivery. Share your store link with your audience. Every sale processes automatically, and you retain full ownership of your infrastructure. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution. You’re not just [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-ebooks-without-paypal-honest-side-side-breakdown-7|COREMERCH guide to selling]] an ebook; you’re building a commerce system that works anywhere, for anyone, on your terms. Deploy today, and take control of your digital commerce.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment works by verifying cryptocurrency transactions on-chain via NOWPayments. Once payment confirms, a webhook triggers backend logic hosted on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This script retrieves the ebook from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and sends a download link to the buyer’s email. The entire process is automated, secure, and runs on infrastructure you own. No Stripe, no PayPal, no platform lock-in. It’s designed for digital creators in regions like Kenya, where traditional payment gateways are unavailable. The system is modular, cost-effective, and built to scale. You own the code, the data, and the process—full sovereignty, zero dependencies.
Crypto payments open global markets without geographic restrictions.

Ready to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack? The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints, templates, and guides for instant deployment. It’s everything you need to build a fully automated ebook delivery system that accepts crypto payments globally. No technical expertise required—just follow the step-by-step instructions. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for managed deployment, or Complete Builder Kit ($197) for full control. 2. Set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your store frontend. 3. Configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment verification and file delivery. 4. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store order data securely. 5. Upload your ebook files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant delivery. 6. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing—connect your wallet and configure webhooks. 7. Test the system end-to-end: simulate a purchase to ensure payment triggers automated delivery. 8. Deploy your store and share the link with your audience. 9. Monitor sales and manage orders through your database. 10. Scale as needed—add more products, optimize workflows, and expand your reach globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are deployed for you within 48 hours. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and templates for self-deployment. No coding required—just follow the instructions.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?

NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON—transactions cost under $0.10. Buyers pay in their preferred currency, and you receive payment in your chosen coin.
Do I need to manage servers or pay ongoing fees?

No. The system uses serverless infrastructure like Cloudflare Workers and GitHub Pages. There are no server management tasks or recurring fees beyond the initial deployment cost and NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction fee.
What happens if a payment fails or is disputed?
The system only triggers delivery once payment is confirmed on-chain. Disputes are handled at the crypto network level—not your responsibility. You retain full control over your products and data.
Can I scale this system for multiple products?

Yes. The architecture is modular and scalable. Add more products by updating your database and file storage. The Edge Commerce Stack and Complete Builder Kit include scaling playbooks for growing your store.
Automated delivery means you focus on creating, not logistics.
